claims.summary: The V0.16.90 production course completed correctly but briefly showed a stale local-save failure before recovering.
A serialized IndexedDB write could settle after a newer save intent and overwrite the current header with stale status.
Only the newest autosave attempt may settle visible saved, failed, or idle state, and workspace reset invalidates queued callbacks.
Exact browser persistence retries one transient storage abort and preserves both causes if the retry also fails.
Chromium preserves oversized exact projects and restores a quota-saturated 15-lesson package from IndexedDB without a visible local-save failure.
One typed source-evidence brief is reused across the syllabus, lesson plans, rubrics, study guides, Agent context, and DOCX export.
Lesson Plans, Rubrics, and Study Guides expose source claims and links while internal compiler labels are rejected from learner-facing output.
The current-source research switch keeps its thumb inside a fixed visual track across desktop, mobile, light, dark, pointer, and keyboard states.
Five frozen domains prove mechanical evidence propagation across teaching surfaces without converting that result into instructor, truth, accessibility, or classroom quality.
The exact local Digital Accessibility export contains 47 entries, 34 valid Office containers, grounded evidence headings, improved learner wording, and zero rejected internal phrases.
The release changes persistence, compiler projection, evidence presentation, and toggle geometry while adding no weights, adapter, factual, instructor, accessibility, classroom, or paid-model claim.
